sentences.en: Mullerian agenesis is the second most common cause of primary amenorrhea after gonadal dysgenesis.

sentences.en: Methods The clinical manifestations and MRI findings of 12 patients with callosal agenesis were analyzed retrospectively , in the meantime the relative literatures were reviewed.

sentences.en: Another diagnosis to consider is a closed spinal dysraphism, where the vertebral arches are not fused well, but there is no vertebral column agenesis.

sentences.en: We present a 18-year-old young lady with primary amenorrhea due to mullerian agenesis.
